en: Colorized vintage image showing a lakeside or riverside pavilion with two round corner towers and red-tiled roofs, likely a grand café or lakeside casino. Numerous white outdoor tables and chairs line a terrace along the water. Several small rowboats and canoes are on the calm water in the foreground, with people boating. Behind the building are trees and, further back, more villa-style buildings with towers and domes in a wooded, hilly setting. There is no visible printed text on the image side.
